architecture_override.authority: Explicit live user authorization: ADR-0012 governs Logical Tunnel multipath/lifecycle; ADR-0011 governs per-lane same-association bootstrap/no-HOL. ADR-0013/0014/0015 are withdrawn where they globalize single-flow.
architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE. A Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 independent complete WBD Transport Lanes. Normal policy maintains 1 lane; Game/weak-network policy may maintain 2..4 lanes. A -> A+B -> B is REQUIRED for planned healthy make-before-break replacement, and candidate failure preserves A; private replacement capacity may reach four logical lanes plus one physical candidate incarnation without creating a fifth logical lane. Any global one-flow reinterpretation, max-lanes=1 rollback, Game disablement, ordinary Reality TCP followed by separate FakeTCP payload, or break-before-make healthy replacement is an ARCHITECTURE REGRESSION. Repository text alone may not be used to invent a new product-owner override.
architecture_override.adr0014: ADR-0014 is withdrawn / invalidated and not current authority.
architecture_override.human_authority_rule: Architecture override requires explicit live user authorization.
architecture_override.candidate_semantics: A make-before-break candidate is a new transport incarnation of an existing logical LaneID 1..4. Private transport slot 5 is overlap capacity and is not a fifth logical Game lane or a second logical PacketID namespace.
architecture_override.multipath: Normal desired=1; Game desired=2..4. Independent lane transport state shares one Logical Tunnel identity/lease and one SessionID/PacketID race domain. First valid arrival wins; duplicate suppressed; no cross-lane HOL.
architecture_override.replacement: Generation-fenced make-before-break; candidate failure preserves healthy old lane; Game rotates one lane at a time.
architecture_override.game_semantics: First valid arrival wins, duplicates are suppressed, and bounded out-of-order unique packets deliver without cross-lane HOL in one shared Logical Tunnel PacketID namespace.
architecture_override.server_path: Shared TUN + one WBD-owned host NAT remains authoritative.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: FakeTCP/Reality/DTLS/LINK/FEC wire is frozen unless deterministic lower-layer evidence proves a defect.
